title: Germany vs Netherlands 5–0: Wirtz Double as Germany Top the Group 🇩🇪 #shorts
description:
Germany beat the Netherlands 5–0 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin on 16 November 2026 to finish top of UEFA Nations League Group A2. Germany, the Netherlands and Greece all finished on 11 points; Germany and the Netherlands reach the quarter-finals.

title: F1 Once Raced in a Las Vegas Car Park 🏁 Every Vegas GP Winner #F1 #shorts
description:
Before the Las Vegas Strip race, Formula One raced in the car park of Caesars Palace hotel in 1981 and 1982, on a flat 2.268-mile, 14-turn track that ran anti-clockwise. Alan Jones (Williams) won in 1981, when Nelson Piquet clinched his first world title by finishing fifth, and Michele Alboreto (Tyrrell) won in 1982. Since F1 returned to the Strip, Max Verstappen won in 2023 and 2025 and George Russell won in 2024. The 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix is on Saturday 21 November.

title: Most Points in an NBA Game: Wilt 100, Bam Adebayo 83, Kobe 81 🤯 #NBA #shorts
description:
The most points in an NBA game is Wilt Chamberlain's 100 for the Philadelphia Warriors against the New York Knicks on 2 March 1962. Second is Bam Adebayo's 83 for the Miami Heat against the Washington Wizards in March 2026, which passed Kobe Bryant's 81 against the Toronto Raptors in 2006. Wilt also scored 78, and four 73-point games share fifth: Chamberlain twice, David Thompson (1978) and Luka Dončić (2024). There have been 16 games of 70 or more points, by 11 players (as of November 2026).
